opentargets.name: Recessive hereditary methemoglobinemia type 2
opentargets.description: Autosomal recessive type 2 hereditary methemoglobinemia, also referred to as recessive congenital methemoglobinemia type 2 (RHM type 2/RCM type 2), is a rare red cell disorder characterized by severe encephalopathy with generalized dystonia and mild cyanosis.

opentargets.name: hereditary methemoglobinemia
opentargets.description: Methemoglobinemia inherited in an autosomal recessive pattern. It is caused by deficiency of the enzyme NADH methemoglobin reductase or the presence of abnormal hemoglobin M. It presents with cyanosis early in life. There is no evidence of cardiopulmonary disease present.

opentargets.name: methemoglobinemia due to deficiency of methemoglobin reductase
methemoglobinemia
opentargets.description: An inherited or acquired condition characterized by abnormally increased levels of methemoglobin in the blood.
